Title: Jyhad Online : computer troubles and inputs for improvement

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
So I've tried the "official" Jyhad Online, and there are many things to be
said before it actually is what we always dreamt of (sort of : I will always
prefer to play with real players, but still...). So I thought we could start
a constructive thread with all the ideas / inputs / comments of people who
actually tested it.

I think the "it's still unstable and I'm getting disconnected all the time"
part is not worth mentionning more than once, because that's exactly why
it's still free and being worked upon. So it's done and said, let's move on.

First I'll mention I use a 19" flat screen with 1280/1024 resolution (as
that might have some consequences on the way I see the interface)

- I have been experiencing some serious troubles with my computer (screen
freezing, video card issues etc) since I've installed the last update, I had
to remove the game and now it looks like my troubles are gone. I'm not sure
it's in direct connection but as of now it sure looks that way. Did anyone
experience the same thing ?

- I always have to find a suitable place for the "commands" window
(reactions / combat...), as its default position hides some other infos
(namely the "stealth / intercept" window)

- I know that the personnal chats have been excluded for cheating reasons
(well, cheaters can still use msn if they're really big cheating morons) but
it would be nice for players not involved in games to be able to talk
privately. I guess that could be done ?

I surely will have more things to say but can't recall right now.

What about you fellow players ?
--
Orpheus

Messages.Author: groin...@googlemail.com
Messages.Body:
Well.

I decided to reboot the only PC i have (which is generally being
linuxy) and give this a try...

Here's a brief synopsis of the experience so far:

Download and Install, fine.

Create account, fine.

Run the thing and login...

First bit of information:
"You don't have the images for this game, download now?"

Why NOT? What the hell is IN the install file, if not the files
required for the game? If it had been images for the newest additions
that were missing, OK, but this list included the pool counters,
stealth markers - the very most basic elements aren't in the
installation?

I click OK to get the images (i'm obviously not getting any further by
clicking "no"...
"Shutting Down" -> What?!? I only just logged in!

Begin downloading images.
20 minutes pass, I have to leave for work, images are about 30% done by
the progress bar
(I have a 2MBit connection, btw)

Come back for lunch, try some more...
Images are done now, no "all done, go back" button though, I have to
close the dialog - confirmation of success is a good thing in UI...

Re-login -> CRASH!

restart, login -> CRASH!

restart, login -> CRASH!

restart, login -> "You don't have the images for this game"
(what comes at this point to mind is unprintable!)

do another download session, takes about 5 minutes this time.

restart, login -> CRASH!

restart, login...

and thats where I've got to.

Glad I'm not paying for this...

(I'm a professional software engineer by trade, and have specifically
worked in software quality assurance, and DAMN this is not a commercial
release quality product, not by a LONG, LONG way)
